Messages.Author: Aaron
Messages.Body:
Propaganda:
"(D) Bleed with +1 bleed. Vampires with titles cannot block this
action. (S) As above, and the Methuselah you are bleeding taps one of
his or her ready untapped minions."

At the superior, when does the tap happen? When I announce the
action?
If the action is blocked, is the minion still tapped?
If I am bleeding someone, who only controls 1 untapped vampire, can he
tap that vampire to use a deflection/misdirection in response to my
action?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Aaron wrote:
>
> Propaganda:
> "(D) Bleed with +1 bleed. Vampires with titles cannot block this
> action. (S) As above, and the Methuselah you are bleeding taps one of
> his or her ready untapped minions."
>
> At the superior, when does the tap happen? When I announce the
> action?

No. Effects of actions are applied when actions resolve. [6.2.3]

> If the action is blocked, is the minion still tapped?

No. [6.2.3]

> If I am bleeding someone, who only controls 1 untapped vampire, can he
> tap that vampire to use a deflection/misdirection in response to my
> action?

Yes.
